Azure Automation is pleased to announce: General Availability of in-support PowerShell 7.6  runbooksRuntime Environment GA, enabling customers to seamlessly upgrade their outdated scripts to supported runtime versions.  Support for Azure CLI commands in PowerShell 7.6 runbooks GA Benefits: Stay current – Access to new language versions for improved security and performance. Faster Runbook upgrade – Easy portability of runbooks across different versions to keep pace with PowerShell and Python releases. Granular control – Complete control to configure the script execution environment, without worrying about conflicting module versions. Efficient Code organization – Eliminate the need to create multiple Automation accounts to segregate different versions of modules or conflicting modules. Learn more:
